QuestInfo.name: Sparks and Subterfuge
QuestInfo.0: After you reach Level 60, the headmaster strikes up a conversation with you.
QuestInfo.1: The Headmaster says that you have an urgent #bSpecial Training#k Field Trip, and that you need to meet your teacher in class. It must be #banother Resistance mission#k! Hurry to the #bUnderground Base#k and talk to #b#p2151000#, the Blaster Job Instructor#k.
QuestInfo.2: You have a new mission for the Resistance to be carried out at the Power Plant, the Black Wings' hideout. Although it will be tough, you have no plans of giving up!

0.0: Greetings, #h0#. You've grown so much since our last meeting! It's such a delight to have such a capable and passionate student like you.
0.1: Today we have a very important #bSpecial Training#k  Field Trip planned for students who have demonstrated outstanding performance on their assignments. I'd be grateful if you were to participate.

yes.0: Your #bhomeroom teacher#k will brief you on the #bSpecial Training#k Field Trip in the classroom, #h0#. Head to the #bschool#k and find out what the field trip entails. I look forward to hearing of your adventure!

no.0: I do hope you change your mind. I think you'll find this particular activity electrifying!

1.0: Long time no see, #h0#. You've come a long way. I can tell by the scratches on your Arm Cannon that you've got a lot of interesting stories to tell! For now though, we've got a mission on our hands.
1.1: This mission is a little bit of a toughie, but I think you're up for the challenge. Want to hear more?

yes.0: Great! Your next mission will take you to the #bpower plant used by the Black Wings as their hideout#k, so if there's anything you need to do to prepare, I suggest you do it now.

0.msg: You haven't attended that  #bSpecial Training#k  Field Trip I told you about yet? Hurry over to the #bSchool#k and find your classroom. Your #bhomeroom teacher#k will be waiting for you.

1.msg: #b('Special Training?' It must be another Resistance mission! Go to the School and hurry over to the Resistance Underground Base to talk to #p2151000#!)#k
